content:
sara-sales: Heads up — enterprise prospect (regulated fintech) wants an air-gapped POC. They need: sealed bundle, offline bootstrap, quarterly patch window, signed deltas, and an SOC-level questionnaire answered. Can we confirm feasibility and rough pricing? :eyes:
pranav-se: doable but need specifics on env: OS, available jumpbox, HSM/KMS, and whether they allow any egress to our signing service (likely not).
luca-eng: From runtime side: we can produce a minimal boot image + model bundle (quantized) and a sidecar updater that applies signed chunked deltas. No outbound required if we ship signed deltas ahead of time.
sara-sales: env: RHEL 8, no outbound, customer will provide an internal jumpbox for S3-like blob hosting. HSM is listed as "optional" in questionnaire.
olivia-sec: Important Qs for security questionnaire: code signing key custody, SBOM for both boot image and model bundle, CVE disclosure timeline, process for emergency hotfixes. We need to state SLA for critical security patches.
pranav-se: For the POC we can do a one-off signed bundle + installer. For long-term, recommend delta approach (signed chunks) with a signed manifest so operator can validate before applying.
luca-eng: Packaging notes: we produce: 1) boot-iso (sha256), 2) runtime tar.gz (sha256 + signature), 3) model bundle chunks (N files, each signed). We'll include a simple verification CLI: `rwd-verify --manifest manifest.json --sig manifest.sig`.
pranav-se: Example verification snippet to give ops: ```
# on jumpbox
sha256sum --check manifest.sha256
./rwd-verify --manifest manifest.json --key /opt/keys/company-root.pub
```
alex-tse: Pricing sketch for internal use: POC packaging + signed bundle: one-time $12k (includes engineering & packaging). On-prem license: $X/year (TBD) + support tier. Air-gap delivery and extra signing work + SBOM export: add $4k. Final numbers need quoting.
sara-sales: customer asked about upgrade cadence — they want monthly security patches but only quarterly feature updates. Can we support that?
luca-eng: Yes — we can ship security deltas on a monthly cadence and mark feature deltas for quarterly bundle shipments. The updater can selectively apply by tag (security vs feature).
olivia-sec: For the questionnaire: we should commit to critical CVE patch within 30 days for supported branches, and provide a runbook for emergency patching. Also, we must document key rotation process and compromised-key remediation steps.
carla-legal: Need to confirm indemnity language for offline installs in the SOW. Also check export control for certain model weights (if any). I'll loop in contracts.
pranav-se: Ops details to confirm with customer: how they want to validate signatures (do they want us to ship public key, or to use their corporate KMS?), path for audit logs, and whether we can include a signed SBOM and attestations.
sara-sales: Customer says they will host blobs on internal MinIO, and they prefer we ship our public signing key as part of the initial artifact bundle. They asked about rekey cadence.
olivia-sec: Recommend rotating signing keys annually; immediate rotation if compromise suspected. We'll provide a rekey manifest signed by both old and new keys for a smooth handover.
luca-eng: Small ops note: delta format is Content-Addressed diffs. To apply locally: `rwd-updater apply --manifest manifest.json --chunks ./chunks/` — this is deterministic and verifiable.
pranav-se: We'll create a short POC runbook (install steps, verify checksums, apply delta) and an acceptance checklist (basic inference smoke, latency spot-check, verify no egress calls).
sara-sales: timeline: they want POC in 4 weeks. Is that realistic?
luca-eng: 4 weeks is tight but doable if they provide jumpbox and test infra this week. Week 1: bundle build + SBOM, Week 2: internal test, Week 3: packaging + docs, Week 4: onsite or remote run.
alex-tse: Commercial ask: we should include a staging fee for airgap validation (3 days on customer infra) — recommend $3k. Also propose a 6-month trial license to start.
carla-legal: I'll prep a minimal SOW addendum for air-gapped delivery and include acceptance criteria.
deploy-bot: Build finished: `artifact://bundles/1756789012-sealed-poc-v1.tar.gz` (sha256: b6a1f9d2...) :white_check_mark:
pranav-se: Thanks. I'll draft the POC runbook and the security answers. Will tag @olivia-sec with the questionnaire draft.
olivia-sec: I'll review and add required attestations. Also want to add a line on audit log retention (default 90 days, configurable).
sara-sales: Awesome. I'll send preliminary quote and SOW draft today and request their jumpbox creds for a test account. :thumbsup:
